### Step 1: Independent Falsification

* **Hypothesis 1:** **Falsified.** The abstract does not mention V or Ce trace-element ratios, $\delta^{18}\text{O}$ or $\delta^{26}\text{Mg}$ isotopic signatures, systematic vertical/lateral profile variations of those signatures, or modulation by deformation and metamorphism. It is also framed as a future analytical proposal (LA-ICP-MS, EPMA, U-Pb geochronology) and omits the central mechanism reported in the abstract (generation of iron-rich ultrabasic melts via interaction of silicate melts with oxidized $\text{P-F-SO}_4$-bearing sedimentary rocks).
* **Hypothesis 2:** **Survived falsification.** Every component aligns directly with the abstract: magnetite-(apatite) deposits form by crystallization of Fe-rich, Si-Al-poor ultrabasic melts, which are generated by the interaction of silicate magma with oxidized sediments (sedimentary rocks) and separate from the silicate magma to crystallize as the deposits. There are no contradictions or unsupported leaps.
* **Hypothesis 3:** **Falsified.** The abstract does not mention El Laco, mantle-depth segregation at $1\text{–}2\text{ GPa}$ and $1200\text{–}1300^\circ\text{C}$, Paleozoic P-rich ironstones, host andesite, specific $^{206}\text{Pb}/^{204}\text{Pb}$ or $^{87}\text{Sr}/^{86}\text{Sr}$ ratios, quantitative AFC parameters/partition coefficients ($100\text{ tons}$, $0.1$, $1.5$), or experimental equilibration at $100\text{–}200\text{ MPa}$ and $900\text{–}1200^\circ\text{C}$. It also reverses the causal sequence in the abstract, which states that crustal rock assimilation during ascent promotes the separation of the Fe-rich, Si-Al-poor melts from a silicate magma rather than mantle-level immiscibility occurring first.
* **Hypothesis 4:** **Falsified.** It misstates the interacting phase—claiming *Fe-rich immiscible melts* interact with sedimentary rocks, whereas the abstract states that *silicate melts* interact with oxidized $\text{P-F-SO}_4$-bearing sedimentary rocks to generate and separate the iron-rich ultrabasic melts. It also introduces unsupported specifics (P-rich ironstones, $\pm 800\text{–}1000^\circ\text{C}$, $\pm 300\text{–}500\text{ MPa}$, specific Pb isotope ratios) and is framed as a future mass-spectrometry study.

### Step 2: Calibrated Selection Gate

Only **Hypothesis 2** survives independent falsification, accurately summarizing the core genetic mechanism supported by the study's abstract without unsupported additions or contradictions.

CHOICE: 2
CONFIDENCE: 5
